errors.evidence: The description lists the countries shown in the chart but omits Slovenia (Словения), which is one of the seven countries represented by a line.

errors.text_span: На графиката са представени шест линии
errors.evidence: The chart shows seven data series (lines) for seven different countries, but the description incorrectly states there are six lines.
The description claims the lines have round markers, but none of the lines in the chart have any visible markers.
In the description for Estonia, the starting value is stated as approximately 0.11%, but the chart shows it starting significantly lower, at about 0.07%.
In the description for Estonia, the ending value is stated as approximately 0.13%, but the chart shows it ending lower, at about 0.08%.
In the description for Latvia, the starting value is stated as approximately 0.11%, while the chart shows it starting much lower, at about 0.07%.
In the description for Latvia, the ending value is stated as approximately 0.12%, but the line on the chart remains low and ends at about 0.07%.
In the description for Croatia, the ending value is stated as approximately 0.14%, but the chart shows it ends lower, at about 0.12%.
In the description for Lithuania, the ending value is stated as approximately 0.16%, but the line on the chart ends higher, at about 0.18%.
